# DEC ledger conflates ADRs with auto-generated change records (49/62)

49 of 62 DEC artifacts are auto-generated change records (tags: change-record, auto-generated); the DEC type conflates design decisions with per-commit bookkeeping. A regulator asking "show me the design decisions backing this release" is handed 49 two-line stubs plus 13 real ADRs. Additionally DEC-CHANGERE-7c39 is review_status: reviewed with risk_profile tier 2 / irreversibility irreversible / blast_radius_count 0 — generated and reviewed by the same pipeline, with a blast radius that contradicts its own tier.

Lenses: regulator, temporal_drift.

Recommended actions:
1. Add a dec_kind discriminator (adr vs change_record) so ledgers, counts, and future schema evolution can treat them separately.
2. Auto-generated change records should not self-record review_status: reviewed; capture reviewer identity separately.
3. Audit blast_radius_count vs tier consistency.
